advice: Abstain from proposing a B-panel packing change. The supplied evidence does not confirm that the full512 kernel accepts a prepacked B layout through the same no-transpose ABI; the earlier advice explicitly identified this compatibility gap. The 32-row helper was already tested in sixteen bands and showed no repeatable gain, so repeating that layout is not a distinct experiment. A B-panel experiment needs a verified compatible consumer or a coordinated generated-kernel layout change, which the supplied evidence does not specify.
risks: Changing only parameters[4] could produce incorrect results if the full512 kernel still interprets and packs B using its existing layout. Packing also adds allocation and copy work to the timed call. Do not treat prior joint panel results as evidence about B packing or assign them to one advisor.
